FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
HealthWise Medical Supplies operates as a retail store specializing in the sale and rental of a wide variety of verified and FDA-approved medical equipment and supplies. Our focus is on ensuring high standards of customer safety and product quality, with a commitment to maintaining compliance with all relevant health and safety regulations. We provide comprehensive staff training on equipment usage, customer safety, and emergency procedures, fostering a knowledgeable and responsive team. 

Our store features a clean, well-lit, and organized retail space, regularly inspected for safety and accessibility to minimize the risk of incidents. We strictly adhere to structured procedures for the sanitization and maintenance of all rental equipment between uses, following guidelines to ensure that all items are in excellent working condition. HealthWise Medical Supplies prides itself on its proactive loss control program, including regular audits, incident reporting, and promptly addressing customer concerns to uphold our high standards of service. Through these measures, we aim to deliver exceptional service while effectively managing risks and ensuring a safe environment for both our customers and staff.
